mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_message (id, msg_id, biz_type, biz_no, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{msgId}, #{bizType}, #{bizNo}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, msg_id, biz_type, biz_no, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, claim_time, create_time FROM local_message WHERE status IN (0, 3) AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW()) AND MOD(id, #{shardTotal}) = #{shardIndex} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE local_message SET status = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE local_message SET status = 3, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 SECOND) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE local_message SET status = 3, next_retry_time = NOW() WHERE status = 2 AND claim_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutSeconds} SECOND)
